description: Canonical terms for the Valmet 2019 Report-to-LCA Evidence demo.

keywords.short: A readable summary of one evidence group.
keywords.definition: An evidence card converts machine extraction results into a compact human-readable explanation with values, source pages, applicability and limitations.

keywords.short: Report evidence mapped to GHG Protocol Scope 3 categories.
keywords.definition: Scope 3 evidence records category-level value-chain emissions, such as purchased goods, transportation, business travel and downstream distribution.

keywords.short: Evidence usable for screening hypotheses but not rigorous product LCA.
keywords.definition: A screening_lca_ready evidence item has a useful direction or approximate value but lacks full functional unit, product-specific inventory or method details required for rigorous product-level LCA.

keywords.short: Evidence usable for company-level environmental inventory review.
keywords.definition: Corporate inventory-ready evidence includes values such as Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions with units and reporting year, but may still be too aggregated for product-level LCA.

keywords.short: Evidence ready for Scope 3 category coverage or value-chain analysis.
keywords.definition: Scope3_evidence_ready means the report provides a category, value, unit and year that can support Scope 3 evidence mining, although not necessarily product-level LCA.

keywords.short: External assurance with restricted scope and level of certainty.
keywords.definition: Limited assurance indicates an external assurance provider reviewed selected information, but it does not mean every claim in the report is fully audited.
